# SquareRoot

Gives the square root of a number.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
SquareRoot(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number | The number, zero or more. A negative number is a runtime error, and so is null or a value that is not a number. |

## Returns

Number. The non-negative square root of value. The result is exact when value is exact and its square root can be held exactly, as for `2.25`; otherwise it is rounded to the nearest floating-point value. Never null.

## Example

`SquareRoot(2.25)` returns `1.5`.
